title: What a crush is
answer: A crush is a strong feeling of liking or being attracted to someone. You might think about them often, feel excited when you see them, or feel shy around them. Crushes are a normal part of growing up and can happen at any age. You can have a crush on a classmate, a neighbour or even a famous person. Having a crush does not mean you must act on it. It is simply a feeling, and it often passes with time.

answer: Talking often can feel nice at first, but if your partner calls or texts all day, demands instant replies, or gets angry when you are busy, it can become controlling. You have the right to time for school, family, friends and rest. Explain kindly that you care but need space at certain times. A healthy partner will understand. If they keep demanding or threatening, that is a warning sign; talk to a trusted adult.

title: Keeping your friends while dating
answer: When you start dating, it is easy to spend all your time with your partner, but your friends and family still matter. They support you, have fun with you and help you see things clearly. Make time for friends, keep your hobbies, and don't cancel plans every time your partner calls. A healthy relationship adds to your life; it does not replace everything else.
